melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.v.label: hidden_provider_report
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.v.role: Module holding the one renderer of where a class lookup's class is bound, shared by the reports that name hidden providers.

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.v.label: HiddenProviderReport
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.v.role: Pure, stateless renderer of hidden candidates, shared by HIDDEN_PROVIDER, Phase 6's empty-collection report, UnresolvedInputError and Phase 3's SpellMap RuntimeError.
responsibilities: describes a candidate id and its spell, or None, as a value dict of spell_id, spell_name, spellframe (a string category as itself, a Protocol by its __name__), spellframe_kind and binding_name (describe)
orders candidates by spellframe, binding_name and spell_name and renders each as '<Name> at (spellframe=..., binding_name=...) - use <lookup>', or 'spell id <id>' when it is not described

renders the lookup that reaches a candidate per shape: SpellMap(spellframe=P, binding_name='b') or SpellMap(Name, binding_name='b') for the single and SpellMap shapes, list[P], list['c'] or list['Name'] for the list shape
counts the SpellMaps the entries show (described_count), so a closing sentence never points at a SpellMap no entry shows
renders the annotation, SpellMap, collection, unresolved-input and Phase 3 RuntimeError texts; reads bind-time fields only, takes no lock and holds no state
